factors.label: Epoch Capabilities Index
factors.description: 60/40 blend of no-date and exact-date direct regressions.

factors.label: API price
factors.description: API price should correlate with model size because larger models generally cost more to serve; we use it as a low-weight cross-check, not a primary signal.

factors.label: No-CoT Time Horizon
factors.description: No-CoT measures how long a task a model can complete without explicit chain-of-thought reasoning; we use that task horizon as our strongest capability-to-parameter scaling signal.

factors.label: Compute-structured AA
factors.description: Training compute should rise with model scale; we map AA and release date through Epoch's compute estimates and use the result as a low-weight structural cross-check.

factors.label: Knowledge capacity
factors.description: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: a direct Fable factual-capacity sensitivity. Its live weight is 0% because promotion requires every predeclared validation gate to pass.

factors.label: Public estimate
factors.description: Geometric mean of parameter-count forecasts from a 20-person poll of researchers and engineers; used only for Fable and Sol.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.methodNote: Distinct newly pretrained base. Exact AA/ECI/date and weak price evidence are observed; METR, no-CoT, IKP, target compute, architecture, and parameter count remain unavailable, so the horizon branch is neutral rather than imputed.

method.combination: Factors are combined in log space. Missing signals are renormalized inside the evidence block, so adding an Fable-only measurement does not silently change Sol's 50% crowd weight.
method.anchors: Disclosed Kimi K3 and Grok 4.5 totals remain fixed under every weighting scenario.
method.currentMix: The default reproduces the audited workbook exactly: 50% crowd for Fable/Sol. IKP receives 0% inside Fable's evidence half under the live audit decision, so the AA/ECI/price/no-CoT/compute block receives the remaining 100%. Sol has no IKP observation.
method.ikp: IKP direct-capacity audit: 93 source configurations collapse to 87 distinct weight bases. On 13 exact models across 11 families, the existing median error is 2.12× versus 1.68× for IKP. A fixed 10% diagnostic blend improves both bootstrap checks, but the later chronological subset has 7 models versus the predeclared minimum of 8; promotion therefore fails and live IKP weight is 0%. The strict pre-Fable, Anthropic-excluded sensitivity is 3.6T. The separate conditional test supports GPQA and MMLU but cannot override the failed primary coverage gate. Sol remains unobserved.
method.noCotDates: No-CoT date audit: all 49 paper checkpoints now have day-level dates, with 4 date-only overrides and 0 parameter identities added. Applying the method-matched exact-date/month-date Pareto slope ratio changes the published time law from 373.0 to 365.9 days and the token law from 437.0 to 438.4 days. The branch weight remains unchanged.
method.noCotArchitecture: No-CoT architecture audit: the paper's 8.1x MoE relationship is exactly reproducible at 8.13x on 5 MoE Pareto models. It remains descriptive rather than a promoted inverse parameter estimator: the separately learned architecture slope worsens strictly chronological developer-held-out error, while the training-fold-only Pareto comparison has a 90% family interval crossing zero. The pooled live mapping and headline forecasts remain unchanged.
method.primaryEvidence: First-party frontier audit: OpenAI reports a 3.6-minute no-CoT horizon for Sol versus 2.3 minutes for GPT-5.5. The fully identified chronological developer-holdout has only 16 predictions across 5 held-out developers, and the developer-balanced interval crosses zero. Plausible mappings of the same point span 1.8T to 11.2T, so its incremental live weight is 0%. Anthropic's system card independently establishes that Fable 5 and Mythos 5 share underlying weights; Opus 4.8 fallback remains a serving-system caveat, not a second base.
method.metrPrimary: METR primary-source audit: all 26 official model rows, 114 scaffold entries, confidence intervals, source versions, and trend-law fields are retained directly from METR's YAML. The earlier copy matches 26/26 rows across every common field with 0 mismatches. This strengthens provenance and losslessness without changing the numerical forecast.
method.operational: Operational cross-check: OpenRouter price remains weakly predictive; all 334 documented endpoint-API requests succeeded and 94.7% of official price rows reconcile exactly to the frontend extraction. The independent AA audit confirms provider-median price on 87 checkpoints and shows 0.83 cross-source price rank correlation, while first-party frontier price, tok/s, and latency add no supported weight.
method.operationalTemporal: OpenRouter temporal cross-check: every refresh is archived byte-for-byte, with default, priority, and flex throughput retained separately. Across 8 immutable snapshots and 60,307 daily rows, default-tier tok/s still fails after price. In a separate 81-checkpoint request-supported audit, no throughput, latency, joint, or tail-spread candidate passes the family-interval plus chronological-direction gate. Tok/s and latency remain at 0%.
method.eciReproduction: ECI reproduction cross-check: the pinned official Epoch implementation reproduces all 213 scores from 2,059 benchmark rows spanning 54 benchmarks. All 196 published nonblank scores agree within two-decimal display rounding. The audit preserves 43 input-date/release-date disagreements and uses the published checkpoint release date for chronological regression.
method.eciFit: ECI fit tournament: 15 hash-pinned vintages yield 27 first-observed tests, including 2 interval-prospective Kimi checkpoints. The flexible ridge form cuts the 25-row selection median error, but fails the inverse-CI prospective veto and spans 1.34x for Fable and 1.38x for Sol across weighting/base-collapse sensitivities. Because both targets are 8.8–10.2 ECI points beyond the open-weight calibration range, the live linear blend is retained.
method.k3Efficiency: K3 efficiency stress test: the statement that a target is at least as parameter-efficient as disclosed 2.780T Kimi K3 is represented by a center-preserving upper-tail projection, not another point-estimate factor or literal conditioning. K3-relative AA and retained log-linear ECI mappings are judgmentally pooled in log space, with target and K3 dates held equal. The default applies winsorization to 80% of upper-tail draws; a below-center reference is overridden by the center. Point centers, lower tails, the exact 50% Fable/Sol crowd blend, and the rejected nonlinear ECI form remain unchanged.
method.activePrice: Active-price cross-check: 63 labels—45 disclosed active counts plus 18 primary-config dense controls—produce 45 release-ordered developer-held-out tests. The config audit parsed 73 repositories and retains 14 gated repositories as unresolved. Active-to-total MoE transport improves point metrics on 16 high-sparsity models, but its seven-developer interval crosses zero and target prices extrapolate beyond training support. It remains a 0%-weight sensitivity.
method.historicalPrice: Historical-price cross-check: a hash-pinned ledger rebuilt from 1,062 committed official OpenRouter catalog snapshots retains 914 model IDs and 2,566 price changes from 21 Sep 2024. All 93 calibration aliases match exactly; 73 total-size and 55 active-size labels have eligible first-day prices. Launch-vintage price beats date alone in every predeclared 1–90 day window, but no active-size window adds a developer-cluster interval wholly below zero beyond AA score plus date. The first-day K3-anchored sensitivities are 5.4T for Fable and 3.8T for Sol; incremental weight remains 0%.
method.components: ECI component cross-check: no individual benchmark survives familywise correction. A separately nested multivariate model moves the 73-fold median error from 2.32× to 2.10×, but its family interval crosses zero; the narrow-ECI-CI replication also crosses zero. The split is aggregate-score uncertainty, not parameter-disclosure status. Incremental component weight remains 0%.
method.posttraining: Post-training lineage cross-check: 686 Epoch base links narrow to 212 candidate open-language, unchanged-size links and 8 measured edges across 6 bases. Later descendants have a median 1.36× ECI-implied scale ratio despite identical size; ECI collapse is inconclusive and AA has only 3 prediction edges. Opus 4.5–4.8 and GPT-5–5.5 remain user-supplied shared-lineage assumptions, not public disclosures. Incremental correction weight remains 0%.
method.aaExpansion: AA expansion cross-check: 94 unique open-weight checkpoints were tested with strict chronological developer holdout. Broad tail error improves, but the 15 frontier-like tests are neutral, so the expanded-panel AA weight remains 0%.
method.aaInference: AA inference-budget cross-check: the complete 587-record snapshot yields 275 open-weight checkpoints and 100 same-checkpoint reasoning pairs. The measured equal-creator uplift is about six AA points, but token-budget and reasoning-standardized frontier intervals cross zero, so both incremental weights remain 0%.
method.activeTransport: Active-parameter cross-check: K3 discloses exactly 2.78T total and 104.2B active parameters. The held-out transport comparison remains inconclusive; K3-anchored sensitivities are 3.8T for Fable and 3.2T for Sol, so incremental weight remains 0%.
method.computeDependency: K3 has one explicitly speculative Epoch training-compute estimate, while no live target has a primary-source compute disclosure. The branch otherwise predicts compute from AA and date, so it remains correlated regularization rather than independent target evidence.
